records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Net sales were $95.7 million for the three months ended March 31, 2024 compared to $82.5 million in the three months ended March 31, 2023, an increase of $13.2 million, or 16.0%.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Net sales at our Work Truck Attachments segment were $23.8 million for the three months ended March 31, 2024 compared to $19.2 million in the three months ended March 31, 2023, an increase of $4.6 million.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: The increase in sales in the three months ended March 31, 2024 was due to price increases, as well as higher parts and accessories sales when compared to the same period in the prior year, as several major cities on the I-95 corridor on the East Coast saw their first measurable snowfall in over 700 days during the first quarter of 2024.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: The increase in sales for the three months ended March 31, 2024 compared to the same period in 2023 is a result of higher volumes and pricing at our Work Truck Solutions segment and higher parts and accessories volumes and pricing at our Work Truck Attachments segment.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Net cash used in operating activities decreased $35.3 million from the three months ended March 31, 2023 to the three months ended March 31, 2024.
